decisions.reason: As a more distant but strategically important flagship for digital finishing, it still carries above-average withdrawal risk if results stay below aspiration, yet continued commitment and strategic fit make retention more likely than exit.
Because this module extends the firm's established modular postpress workflow and no negative signal is reported, management would likely judge it as meeting acceptable aspirations and keep it.
This flagship B2 multifinisher is closely aligned with the firm's core automation direction, so after remaining in the range it is very unlikely to be dropped absent clear underperformance.
The hybrid saddle stitcher fits the firm's traditional booklet-making business, and with no evidence of failure boundedly rational management would normally continue it while monitoring demand.
An observed customer installation gives concrete evidence of use and problem-solution fit, which puts the product comfortably above aspiration and makes withdrawal unlikely.
